---

## applyTo: "**/*.cs"

# C# Instructions

* Use modern C# and nullable reference types.
* Follow SOLID principles and existing project architecture.
* Use dependency injection instead of manually creating services.
* Keep controllers thin; put business logic in services.
* Prefer `async`/`await` for I/O operations.
* Use meaningful PascalCase names for types/methods and camelCase for variables/parameters.
* Handle exceptions explicitly; do not silently swallow exceptions.
* Do not hardcode secrets, credentials, or connection strings.
* Add or update unit tests when changing business logic.
